question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Warm
solution:
The correct answer is: **Amicable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"warm"** means having or showing enthusiasm, affection, or kindness. (गर्म / स्नेही)

 
 
• **Example:** She gave me a **warm **welcome when I arrived at the party.
 
 
 
• **"Amicable"** refers to having a spirit of friendliness; without serious disagreement or rancor. (मित्रतापूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** They reached an **amicable **agreement after hours of negotiation.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate synonym of '**warm**' is '**amicable**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unkind** (अदयालु): Lacking compassion; not kind.

 
 
• **Example:** His **unkind **remarks hurt her feelings deeply.
 
 
 
• **Hostile** (शत्रुतापूर्ण): Unfriendly; antagonistic.
 
 
• **Example:** The **hostile **crowd made it difficult for the speaker to continue.
 
 
 
• **Mean** (दुष्ट): Unkind, spiteful, or unfair.
 
 
• **Example:** It was **mean **of him to take credit for her work.
